lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca12V8O24 (reduced formula Ca3V2O6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 44 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca centers with six O neighbors in an octahedral motif, while V adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors. O centers coordinate to three Ca and three V neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-sharing between Ca and V octahedra and edge-sharing between Ca octahedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
